reviews.title: MULTILINE_NOTE Element Ambiguous Syntax
reviews.rationale: The multiline-note closing example disagrees with the grammar. Pinned lexical corpus verification remains separate from structural semantic acceptance.

reviews.title: SINGLE_LINE_NOTE and MULTILINE_NOTE Unclear Semantics or Intended Use
reviews.rationale: The issue asks how lexical notes differ from semantic comments. It does not authorize dropping canonical annotations or changing the grammar.

reviews.title: Classifier multiplicity, semantics
reviews.rationale: Classifier multiplicity interpretation asks about instance cardinality. The separate validateClassifierMultiplicityDomain structural rule remains mandatory.

reviews.title: Discrepancy between documentation of Collections library in spec and textual notation file
reviews.rationale: This asks to align documentation text with the specification. Original library bytes and comments are preserved; no structural correction is adopted.

reviews.title: Dynamic multiplicity, semantics
reviews.rationale: Dynamic multiplicity compares evaluated cardinalities over time. This does not defer multiplicity ownership, typing, bound structure or featuring domains.

reviews.title: isReadOnly, semantics
reviews.rationale: Constancy over the entire lifetime of a domain instance requires values and time. The canonical flag and any existing structural restrictions remain required.

reviews.title: isPortion, semantics
reviews.rationale: Temporal/whole-instance interpretation of isPortion is separate from structural flag conformance and required portion specialization. Neither is silently changed.

reviews.title: Model-level evaluability of body expressions
reviews.rationale: Whether a body expression is model-level evaluable can depend on structural operand/referent facts. Do not classify the operation itself as runtime execution merely because actual evaluation is deferred.

reviews.title: Undefined rules in the text notation grammar.
reviews.rationale: The listed undefined grammar references and capitalization require syntax authority review. The owned-cross correction changes no grammar production.

reviews.title: isAbstract, semantics
reviews.rationale: Interpretation of isAbstract refers to which instances exist. The flag and specialization graph remain structurally checkable without choosing an instance interpretation.

reviews.title: FeatureDefinition should not be mandatory in Expression productions
reviews.rationale: The grammar optionality complaint must be distinguished from structural expression semantics. The full pinned corpus parses; no grammar correction is introduced by v7.

reviews.title: isSufficient, semantics, expressiveness
reviews.rationale: Sufficient and necessary extent conditions concern instance interpretation. Structural Type flags and all existing derivations remain required.

reviews.title: Special metaclasses supporting Flow shorthand
reviews.rationale: Longhand FlowEnd and PayloadFeature projections can be empty under the published derivations. The at-most-one payload constraint permits this; the remaining full Flow derivation/validation obligations are not waived.

reviews.title: Occurrence::superoccurrence is in the library, but not in the specification
reviews.rationale: The pinned superoccurrence Feature exists. The issue questions documentation or library intent; source identity and ordinary structural validity must both be preserved until an authorized correction exists.

reviews.title: direction, semantics
reviews.rationale: Who may change a directed value requires instance/time semantics. Structural direction, conjugation and redefinition conformance are not deferred.

reviews.title: Textual notation does not expose inherited members
reviews.rationale: Displaying inherited members with a caret is proposed new notation. Inherited semantic memberships are still required and must not be copied into canonical ownership.

reviews.title: Functions missing (for SysPhSv2)
reviews.rationale: Additional numerical and simulation functions are an extension request. Existing required references and pinned function declarations must remain complete without adding unpinned functions.

reviews.title: User-readable definitions of KerML functions (KerML 9.4)
reviews.rationale: Missing human-readable function definitions do not supply an alternative structural graph. Evaluation semantics remain separate from structural parameter/result validation.

reviews.title: Steps are not always time enclosed
reviews.rationale: Whether a Step happens during its owning occurrence is a temporal interpretation question. Every applicable published Step specialization, with the already authorized target-name corrections, remains mandatory.

reviews.title: Lexical scoping, semantics
reviews.rationale: Lexical name resolution and contextual connector chains must be distinguished. A resolved name alone does not establish the instance-specific binding graph; complete connector/domain analysis remains required.

reviews.title: Decision/MergePerformance element descriptions give incorrect modeling pattern
reviews.rationale: The decision/merge modeling-pattern discrepancy concerns relationships as well as runtime traversals. Exact local union/subsetting/binding populations still need analysis.

reviews.title: Succession cross multiplicities too loose
reviews.rationale: Succession cross-multiplicity structure must be checked independently of the temporal-order interpretation. This issue does not authorize tightening the pinned bounds.

reviews.title: Sufficiency missing for some library types
reviews.rationale: The requested sufficiency of spaceTimeCoincidentOccurrences would change library semantics. Its existing graph must be checked without adding the flag.

reviews.title: Conditions missing for some sufficient library types
reviews.rationale: The sufficient portions Feature is present. The relationship graph and sufficient flag are preserved; proving unintended extent equivalence is distinct from deciding a source correction.

reviews.title: XMI and JSON for model libraries
reviews.rationale: Additional normative XMI/JSON library archives are an artifact request. Pilot reference XMI is corroboration, not replacement authority for pinned library bytes.

reviews.title: Some types not given any semantics
reviews.rationale: No pinned Type instance lies outside Classifier or Feature. This absence is computed below from normative metaclass conformance, not names or reference behavior.

reviews.title: Machine readable project interchange file(s) for language description examples
reviews.rationale: Missing interchange files for language-description examples are an artifact request, not a correction to the three pinned libraries.

reviews.title: Some package-level features are mandatory
reviews.rationale: Package-level features and their bounds are present. Domain structure is mandatory even though the consequences for every runtime instance concern extent interpretation.

reviews.title: Featuring type of the multiplicity of a cross feature
reviews.rationale: Six diagnosed cross-multiplicity bound expressions require a domain analysis separate from both KERML11-4 and the owned-cross selector. No alternative domain is adopted.

reviews.title: Feature values do not specify when their expressions are evaluated
reviews.rationale: Evaluation time for a FeatureValue requires runtime state. Ownership, expression domains, result structure and binding production remain structural and mandatory.

reviews.title: Invariants only hold when evaluated
reviews.rationale: The complaint asks when invariant expressions are evaluated and true. It does not replace the mandatory structural specializations of Expression and Invariant.

reviews.title: Inherited multiplicities, semantics
reviews.rationale: Multiplicity ownership and inherited closure remain structural obligations. The disputed cardinality interpretation must not justify omitting inherited graph facts.

reviews.title: Add validateSubsettingTypeConformance constraint
reviews.rationale: The issue proposes an additional static type-conformance constraint. Published subsetting currently accumulates types. Existing typing and disjoining constraints still require independent evaluation; no new presumed-disjointness rule is adopted.

reviews.title: Root namespaces restricted to one single file
reviews.rationale: Merging namespaces across files is proposed new authoring semantics. Duplicate declarations must not be silently merged; current import/namespace rules remain mandatory.

reviews.title: Ambiguity In Directionality InOut semantics
reviews.rationale: Determination and use of inout values concern instance semantics. Explicit direction derivation and parameter/redefinition direction conformance remain structural.

reviews.title: Redefining features sometimes must respecify metaproperties even when they are the same as those of the redefined feature
reviews.rationale: Automatic inheritance of additional metaproperties is proposed. Existing explicit direction/end/conformance rules and v2 redefinition semantics are retained.

reviews.title: Serious limitation of textual concrete syntax as model interchange format for representing UUIDs
reviews.rationale: Textual UUID interchange is a representation limitation. The kernel must preserve canonical identities; it does not authorize changing any library source.

reviews.title: Annex A coverage
reviews.rationale: The issue explicitly concerns execution-algorithm coverage in Annex A. It cannot justify deferring any structural constraint from the normative inventory.

reviews.title: Some syntax in Core has time-dependent semantics
reviews.rationale: The issue questions temporal interpretations of Core flags. It does not remove structural flag, direction, specialization, domain or ownership obligations.

reviews.title: TimeOf::timeContinuityConstraint might be too restrictive
reviews.rationale: The continuity invariant compares evaluated timestamps under alternative time models. Its references and expression/result structure remain structural requirements.

reviews.title: isDerived, semantics
reviews.rationale: Whether every derived Feature value is computable at all times is an evaluation question. Ownership and FeatureValue binding structure must still be checked.

reviews.title: Space triggers missings
reviews.rationale: Quantified-space triggers are a requested library extension. No additional trigger is added to the frozen corpus.

reviews.title: Impossible to specialize (redefine, subset) unnamed features in textual syntax
reviews.rationale: A textual way to specialize anonymous features is an extension request. Canonical identity-based specialization and all references actually present in the pinned corpus still require closure.

reviews.title: TransferBefore is unsatisfiable
reviews.rationale: TransferBefore has a static disjoint-supertype path. An empty extent alone is not forbidden structural syntax. Complete disjoining and multiplicity obligations must establish whether any structural contradiction follows without requiring an instance.

reviews.title: HappensLink disjointness documentation inconsistent
reviews.rationale: The declared disjoining from Occurrence is explicit; the prose names its narrower LinkObject subtype. The graph is preserved, and the separate TransferBefore issue is still analyzed.

reviews.title: Description and semantics of model-level evaluable constructor expressions
reviews.rationale: The prose has not followed a constructor evaluability constraint change. Structural modelLevelEvaluable derivation and actual constructor execution are separate obligations.

reviews.title: Eliminate EndFeatureMembership and ParameterMembership from abstract syntax
reviews.rationale: Eliminating membership metaclasses would change the metamodel. Published membership classes and their constraints remain authoritative in v7.

reviews.title: Problem with nested feature semantics
reviews.rationale: The question distinguishes nested-feature domains from role-type interpretation. Domain and connector structure cannot be deferred; any additional interpretation conflict requires a pinned local proof.

reviews.title: Incorrect succession in state and transition library
reviews.rationale: Interruptibility and run-to-completion concern temporal execution. The exact pinned succession and its references still require structural validation; no source edit is authorized.

reviews.title: Indexing Collection types
reviews.rationale: All 23 reference guards agree, but that is not a proof for the independently expanded pinned graph. The Array guard is unchanged.

reviews.title: TriggerAfter uses a binding to var 'currentTime'
reviews.rationale: Capturing currentTime versus continuously binding it changes values over time. Both default/non-default and initial structural graph cases remain mandatory; the pinned source is unchanged.

reviews.title: Redefinition inheritance anomaly
reviews.rationale: Complete inherited membership and redefinition suppression must be compared with optional redundant-specialization removal; two Triggers findings cannot be waived on the issue title alone.

reviews.title: State::entryAction HappensJustBefore State::doAction
reviews.rationale: The requested immediate start of doAction changes temporal behavior. Existing entry/do-action successions and all their structural constraints still require checking.

reviews.title: OCL for importedMemberships is incorrect
reviews.rationale: Five direct VectorFunctions imported/owned membership collisions now independently prove the prose/OCL disagreement (KLCV10-F-004). Broader cyclic/inherited/visibility closure remains mandatory; no correction is adopted.

reviews.title: Transfers::transfers and Transfers::flowTransfers subset each other
reviews.rationale: All five pinned Flows are longhand. The independently retained transfers/flowTransfers cycle is exercised. A cycle alone is not a structural contradiction; the disjoint MessageTransfer/FlowTransfer types also require analysis before any acceptance claim.

reviews.title: TransitionPerformance::accept is incorrect
reviews.rationale: accept explicitly redefines the second inherited parameter while its local direction-bearing Feature is first. Exact positional and explicit redefinition closure is still required; the reference source change is not authorized.

reviews.title: Type::specializes() Operation shall be Model-Level Evaluable and Accessible from Expressions
reviews.rationale: Exposure of Type::specializes through model libraries is a library/API extension. The existing semantic specialization query remains a mandatory structural operation.

reviews.title: ForAll and Exists Should be Model-Level Evaluable
reviews.rationale: The proposed forAll/exists evaluability rule requires a structural predicate/body classification before execution. No unreviewed evaluability extension is implemented.

reviews.title: Dynamic Metadata Retrieval
reviews.rationale: Dynamic metadata retrieval is a proposed new library/notation facility. Existing metadata ownership, typing and filtering structure must still be validated.

reviews.title: checkConstructorExpressionResultDefaultValueBindingConnector not specified
reviews.rationale: Both constructors inherit default FeatureValues. Missing direct defaults is not an absence proof. Complete default-binding graph analysis remains required.

reviews.title: Message Connector Ends are Absent by Default; If Ends are Specified, Message is Indistinguishable from Flow
reviews.rationale: The disputed FlowConnectionUsage message notation belongs to SysML. No SysML semantic rules or frontend are introduced.

reviews.title: ShapeItems can't be SpatialItems
reviews.rationale: ShapeItems/SpatialItems belong to the Systems Library, excluded from this publication scope. Their geometry is not imported into KerML acceptance.

reviews.title: Missing descriptions of specialized effective naming
reviews.rationale: The specialized PerformActionUsage/RequirementConstraintMembership naming rules belong to SysML. Generic KerML effective naming remains mandatory.
